# FG-AGENT-0011

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 503 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | [`llm-gateway`](../../ops/runbooks/llm-gateway.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `llm_down_returns_rules_with_degraded_flag` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 推薦は決まった規則だけで出しています（AI の理由は今ありません）。部品はそのまま選べます。
- en: The recommendation uses the fixed rules only (no AI reasons right now). You can still pick the parts.
- id: Rekomendasi hanya memakai aturan tetap (alasan AI tidak tersedia saat ini). Anda tetap dapat memilih bagian.

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 16 A11 (ADR-0032 Amendment A11, ADR-0039 Amendment A11): the agent builder's recommendation (`POST …/agent-builder/recommend`) has no local LLM reasons for the default branch's tip, so it answers the rules-only result with `degraded: true` and `source: "rules"` — never an error, never a made-up reason. The code is named in the answer (`llm.error_code`) and the worker's log; it is never an HTTP error (`http_status` is nominal: the route answers 200). The worker's `agent_recommend` task logs this code once per project, tip and cause. `reason`: `llm_unavailable` (the gateway failed: `llm_error` is its FG-LLM code — 0001 down or timed out, 0002 invalid answer twice, 0003 digest mismatch, 0004 queue deadline), `paused` (the gateway is paused: nothing was queued), `input_refused` (FG-LLM-0005: a secret could not be redacted from the input), `no_spec` (the tip has no specification document that may be given — none, or every one is confidential), `confidential_unreadable` (the documents could not be classified by `forge_checks::confidential`: fail closed, nothing is sent; `llm_error` is the git code). A reader also sees `unavailable` when no worker answered an ask within 6 minutes (`llm.enabled = false`, the worker is down).

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The worker's log event carries `task=agent_recommend`, `project_id`, `tip`, `reason` and `llm_error`; the gateway logs its own FG-LLM code with the same `request_id`. The ask's row: SELECT state, head_sha, error_code, advice_id, asked_at, pending_since FROM forge.agent_recommend_asks WHERE project_id = <id>. `forge doctor` (`llm.endpoint`, `llm.model`, `llm.queue_age`) says whether the gateway is up.

## 対処 (fix)

Nothing is blocked: the person picks parts from the rules' recommendation. For `llm_unavailable` / `paused` follow runbook llm-gateway; `input_refused` means a specification document holds a credential (a committed secret is a leak: runbook secret-removal); `no_spec` needs nothing (add an open specification document under the repository's spec directory to get reasons).
